M15 — 2026-10-11 — supersedes drive-lanes M12
Fixture reps (test-e2e/drive-lanes/run.mjs) run with --claude-config ~/.bench/claude-config-build (build@ Max, D27); `node run.mjs --label probe --probe --claude-config <dir>` prints rate_limit_info (five-hour and seven-day utilization) before spending — on 2026-10-11 one 3-lane sonnet rep cost about 1% of the five-hour window. Since 3.4 each cell sets XDG_STATE_HOME to <cell>/state, so reps no longer write ~/.local/state/sofar and can run beside a vitest or a drive verify without tripping the HOME canary.
